name: @orvyn/engine-player
description: Plays Orvyn Engine games (orvyn-game/1) in a canvas: the engine in WebAssembly, keyboard/mouse/touch, sound, TS/JS scripts.

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && esbuild src/player.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/player.js
